name: Cagent
description: Cagent is a sandboxed LXC for running an autonomous coding agent. A fully provisioned Ubuntu container preloaded with Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, and Docker, plus Claude Code and a curated set of plugins (frontend-design, code-review, commit-commands, security-guidance, context7, webapp-testing, superpowers). All agent tools are pre-approved for hands-off use. Code Server is exposed on port 8443 for browser-based editing.

notes.text: A randomly generated Code Server password is written to `~/cagent.creds` inside the LXC. View it with `cat ~/cagent.creds`. To rotate, edit `PASSWORD` in `/docker/code-server/docker-compose.yml` and run `docker compose up -d` from that directory.
Claude Code is preinstalled. Enter the LXC (`pct enter <id>`) and run `claude` to authenticate and start working. The shell auto-cds into `/project`.

All Claude Code tools (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, WebFetch, Task, MCP, etc.) are pre-approved in `~/.claude/settings.json` — there are no permission prompts. This is intended for a sandboxed LXC; do not enable this configuration on a host with sensitive data.
A privileged container with `nesting=1, keyctl=1` is required so Docker (Watchtower + Code Server) can run inside the LXC. AppArmor is set to unconfined.
